resolution: Exclude every target indication query pair from negative corruption; allow only the three unlabelled supports. Apply to KGE/LLaDR and TxGNN/RGCN relation pretraining. Filter known training positives and mask exhausted negative domains.
prior_results: Retained only as superseded pilot artifacts; excluded from manuscript and reproduction package.
selection: No new target-query-based hyperparameter selection. Existing source-validation/refit rules unchanged.
